summary: FreeCell entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: FreeCell
entries.definitive_edition: Classic Windows FreeCell for preservation; Microsoft Solitaire Collection for current access

emulation.emulator: Legacy Windows VM only for historical capture
emulation.notes: Use Microsoft Solitaire Collection for practical current route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Classic Windows FreeCell with exact OS/app version and deal number documented

primary.why: Microsoft FreeCell is the culturally dominant digital FreeCell route after its Windows Entertainment Pack and Windows 95 inclusion. Current Microsoft Solitaire Collection access is practical, while classic Windows builds preserve the original interface and deal-number behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use a classic Windows FreeCell build for historical UI capture, or Microsoft Solitaire Collection for current official access. Record route, game/deal number, scoring/timer settings, hints/undo state, OS/app version, and whether a legacy Windows VM was used.

secondary.why: Classic Windows route better preserves the historical UI.

all_releases.fidelity: Canonical bundled Windows route that popularized the game.
Current Microsoft app route with modern UI and account features.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Current Microsoft app access differs from classic Windows UI, deal-number, and scoring behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Many FreeCell implementations exist; this entry tracks the Microsoft Windows lineage.
